title: The 1812 fort now stands on 14 August, the evacuation's eve
items: The 1812 scene moves from 1 August to the afternoon of 14 August 1812, the day before the garrison marched out, so the Potawatomi camp of that week can stand in it when it is built.

A new card, 'The day you see', says what that day was, in the words of the commanding officer's letter and Wau-Bun, and where the two disagree on dates. Nothing of the day is staged and no one is drawn.
